subject: Unattributed burst in embeddings usage during batch ingest — request for raw logs and VAT treatment
messages:
From: Daniel Morales <dan.morales@greenline.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference>
Cc: Kate O'Neill <kate.oneill@greenline.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:04:00 +02:00
Subject: Sudden embeddings spike Oct 3–4 — raw export and VAT question

Hi Irene,

We're seeing a sudden ~2.3M token increase on our October 3–4 invoices attributed to embeddings calls from our ingest pipeline (project: analytics-ingest-prod). This does not align with our deployment activity — we had a small consumer-facing rollout (low traffic) and a scheduled batch reindex that should have been rate-limited.

Can you please:
- Share a raw export of requests for account GL-439 (request_id, timestamp, model, endpoint, token_counts, client-request-id) for 2026-10-03 00:00 -> 2026-10-04 23:59 UTC.
- Confirm whether duplicate request-ids or replays were observed on Redwood's side.
- Advise on whether we should expect VAT reclassification for the disputed tokens (we're an EU customer invoiced to Ireland). The volume bump pushes us into a different tax threshold for this quarter and we need to flag to finance.

Given the material impact, we'd appreciate a provisional credit while you investigate — something to prevent collections escalation for this invoice. Happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Thanks,
Daniel
Head of Platform
Greenline Analytics Ltd.

--
Attachment: token-sample-window-20261003-04.csv (csv, 5KB)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference>
To: Daniel Morales <dan.morales@greenline.ai>
Cc: Kate O'Neill <kate.oneill@greenline.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 11:18:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Sudden embeddings spike Oct 3–4 — raw export and VAT question

Hi Daniel — thanks for the detailed note and the CSV; sorry for the surprise on your end. We're opening an internal investigation now.

Immediate next steps from our side:
- I'll ask our billing and platform teams to pull the raw request export for the exact window you provided and check for duplicate request-id or replay patterns.
- We'll temporarily place a hold on collections for the disputed line while we validate (this is standard for cases where evidence is pending).
- If we confirm platform-caused duplication, we'll issue a provisional credit and a formal credit note for your accounting team.

Can you confirm the account GUID (you referenced GL-439 in the CSV) and whether we should include any other legal entity info for VAT documentation?

I'll loop in Ben and Monica for billing reconciliation and Aditya for service-level log pulls. Expect an update within 24–36 hours.

Best,
Irene
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: token-sample-window-20261003-04.csv (forwarded)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 11:22:00 +02:00
Subject: Fwd: Sudden embeddings spike Oct 3–4 — GL-439 — action items

Folks — forwarding Greenline's report. TL;DR: large embeddings token spike over Oct 3–4; customer requests raw export and provisional credit while we investigate VAT implications (EU/Ireland).

Please take ownership of the items below and reply-all with timing:
- Ben: start billing reconciliation, identify the invoice line(s) and compute provisional credit suggestion if platform root cause found.
- Monica: prepare VAT documentation checklist and note whether embeddings vs. generation classification affects taxable supply for Ireland.
- Aditya: pull raw request export for GL-439 for 2026-10-03 00:00 -> 2026-10-04 23:59 UTC, include request_id, inbound headers (client-request-id), model, endpoint, token_counts, and server-side dedupe metrics. Also surface any abnormal retry counts originating from the same client IPs.

Please attach findings and any small evidence files (logs/csv) to the thread — we will share with the customer.

Irene

(Internal note: prioritize this; finance flagged that Greenline may push for a formal dispute.)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:05:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Sudden embeddings spike Oct 3–4 — GL-439 — findings + recommendation

Quick update after pulling logs: we observed a replay pattern tied to the customer-side ingest worker. Evidence: ~18k requests with identical client-request-id header but multiple server receipts (duplicate request-ids at the service boundary) between 2026-10-03T14:12:03Z and 2026-10-03T14:26:57Z. Attached a short log excerpt.

Preliminary impact estimate: ~2,150,000 extra embedding tokens accounted as duplicates. Given our billing policy we recommend:
- Issue provisional credit of USD 7,500 for the duplicated tokens (covers the contested line pending final validation).
- Generate a formal credit note (Provisional) for their October invoice and mark the invoice as 'under review' in collections.

Monica: on VAT — embeddings are still a supply of computing/service. For Irish VAT we need the customer's VAT registration (if they supplied reverse-charge details, we can zero-rate; otherwise standard VAT applies). Please advise what documents we need to finalize the credit note.

Attachments: replay-evidence-logs.txt (snippet)
Related link: https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/exports/GL-20261003-raw-logs.csv?presigned

Ben
Director, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Daniel Morales <dan.morales@greenline.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference>
Cc: Kate O'Neill <kate.oneill@greenline.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 13:30:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Sudden embeddings spike Oct 3–4 — raw export and VAT question

Irene / Ben — thanks for the quick triage and the evidence. We accept the provisional credit of USD 7,500 and the invoice hold for collections while you finalize. Please send:
- The formal provisional credit note (PDF) and confirmation of how this will appear on the October statement.
- The full raw export CSV (the presigned link works for us).
- Clarification on VAT: Greenline is VAT-registered in Ireland (VAT IE 3456783K). We'll send a copy of our VAT cert and company registration number to Kate; please confirm whether Redwood will mark the credit as zero-rated under reverse charge or if we should expect net VAT adjustments.

We'd like the final resolution no later than Oct 12 to close quarter reporting. Happy to jump on a 30-min call tomorrow if helpful.

Thanks,
Daniel

--
Attachment: provisional-credit-note-draft.pdf (attached preview)
